assembly.type: ทุกแบบ (3-9 บาน, เปิดด้านเดียว / แยก 2 ฝั่ง) — section p5
assembly.joints: Outer frame: top track M50263 + adaptor M30335 at head, side jambs M50238 + cover M50156, bottom track M30253 recessed into the floor. Each panel is a box of M50288 (stiles + rails, joint type not drawn), glass held by M50291 beads. Leading (lock) edge uses M50289; in split layouts the two stacks meet on M50289 + M50290. Panels hang from top roller FTT01 and are guided by bottom roller FBT01.
assembly.clearances_mm: not dimensioned except overall depth 101.6 (sections at 1:4 on A4); panel stile 72 x 41
assembly.notes: ไม่มีสูตรตัดพิมพ์ในคู่มือ (คู่มือมีแต่รูปตัดติดตั้ง). Not printed: cut lengths, glass sizes. Gaps below are read from the section drawings only. Hardware placement per panel is printed on each elevation: hinged-to-jamb panel gets FH-01/FH-01ST (top) + FH-01 (middle) + FH-01 (bottom); panel-to-panel hinges FH-02 (top) + FH-02H (middle) + FH-02 (bottom); carrying panels FTT01 top + FBT01 bottom; operating panel T28/T29 + CDQ20 + CZ-008A; end panel 300A/400A (lever) — read from p5/p9, small print, estimated.
